def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0:
                continue
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == color for rr in range(r, r + 3) for cc in range(c, c + 3)):
                blocks.append((color, r + 1, c + 1))
    paints = {}
    for color, cr, cc in blocks:
        for x in range(w):
            paints.setdefault((cr, x), set()).add(color)
        for y in range(h):
            paints.setdefault((y, cc), set()).add(color)
    for (r, c), colors in paints.items():
        out[r][c] = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else 0
    return out
PY
